```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

necessary libraries
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(openxlsx)
```

load in gis master file data (so far)
```{r}
gismaster = read.csv("GISmaster.csv", header = TRUE, colClasses = c(ZIP_code_filled = "character"))
```

we create a new column citystatezip, that shows each grants city, state, and zip in one string
```{r}
gismaster$citystate = paste(gismaster$city_filled, gismaster$state_filled, sep = ", ")
gismaster$citystatezip = paste(gismaster$citystate, gismaster$ZIP_code_filled, sep = ", ")
```

we do this to get a new dataframe: uniquecounts. this allows us to see each unique city, state, zip combination and how many times each occurs
```{r}
uniquecounts = gismaster %>%
  count(citystatezip, name = "count") %>%
  select(count, citystatezip)
```

our dataframe works as intended, so we download and observe results in sheets
```{r}
write.xlsx(uniquecounts, "uniquecounts.xlsx")
getwd()
```
